title: UAP activity at nuclear sites
summary: Karl Nell tells of UAP activity at nuclear sites, about unspecified at Washington, D.C., and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Pantex, Texas; Hanford, Washington, USA; Fukushima, Japan

tellings.quote: concerted correlation between um UFO or UAP activity and nuclear sites the pantac site in uh Texas and the Hanford plutonium production Facility have numerous UFO um sightings and correlations and in fact there this extends to overseas sites even the Fukushima incident had um had correlations

plain: Karl Nell, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels in 2024, says there is a strong link between UFO sightings, which officials now call UAP or unidentified anomalous phenomena, and nuclear sites. He names Pantex, a nuclear weapons plant in Texas, and Hanford, a plutonium production site in Washington state, as places with many sightings, and says the pattern reaches overseas, even to the Fukushima nuclear disaster in Japan. If true, it would suggest that whatever is behind the sightings has a particular interest in nuclear power and weapons.
